caption: The drawing depicts a large, rectangular wooden chest of drawers in a reddish-brown hue. The chest consists of five horizontal drawers, with the top drawer divided into two smaller compartments. Each drawer front is decorated with an intricate, symmetrical floral motif, featuring stylized flowers and leaves in various shades of green, cream, yellow, blue, and pink. The flowers and vines are spread across the entire surface of each drawer, and the bases of the floral motifs sit just above the bottom edge of each drawer, giving a sense of rootedness. Each drawer has a single, centrally placed lock escutcheon, rendered in gold or brass color. The piece has short, bracket feet and a simple, smooth molding along the top edge. The background is a plain, beige or off-white color, and no additional objects or scenery are depicted.
title: Painted Chest
